Root cause: when `loop.last` or `loop.nextitem` peeked ahead on a generator, the cached next item was excluded from the remaining iterator used to calculate `loop.length`.

Updated synchronous and asynchronous loop length calculations to account for the cached `_after` item, fixing `revindex` and `revindex0` off-by-one errors.

final_text:
Root cause: when `loop.last` or `loop.nextitem` peeked ahead on a generator, the cached next item was excluded from the remaining iterator used to calculate `loop.length`.

Updated synchronous and asynchronous loop length calculations to account for the cached `_after` item, fixing `revindex` and `revindex0` off-by-one errors.
